results.source: Do not enter the dungeon yet.
results.target: 暫時不要進入地牢。

results.source: Do not follow Player_007 unless Player_007 asks for help.
results.target: 不要跟隨 Player_007，除非 Player_007 請求協助。

results.source: Meet Player_007 near Gate_02 at X:-12 Y:34.
results.target: 請在 X:-12 Y:34（Gate_02 附近）與 Player_007 會合。

results.source: If the bridge is closed, wait by the northern gate. Otherwise, cross the river.
results.target: 若橋閉合，則暫時待在北方門口。否則，渡過河流。

results.source: Never open the chest before the guard leaves.
results.target: 勿開寶箱，直到守衛離開。

results.source: If health is above 30%, gain +12% Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Otherwise, gain +3% Fire Resistance.
results.target: 若生命值高於 30%，獲得 +12% 移動速度，持續 5 秒；否則獲得 +3% 火焰抗性。

results.source: Gain -15% Attack Speed for 10 seconds.
results.target: 獲得 -15% 攻擊速度，持續 10 秒。

results.source: Gain +12.5% Fire Resistance for 2.5 seconds.
results.target: 獲得 +12.5% 火焰抗性，持續 2.5 秒。

results.source: When you block an attack, restore 12 health. This cannot occur more than once every 5 seconds.
results.target: 當你防禦一記攻擊時，恢復12點生命值。此動作不能超過每5秒一次。

results.source: Collect 3/10 moonstones before 01:30. Do not leave the area.
results.target: 收集 3/10 月石於 01:30 前。勿離開區域。

results.source: Defeat 7 wolves, then return to Gate_02.
results.target: 擊敗7隻狼，然後返回至Gate_02。

results.source: Do not use the portal unless all 3 players are ready.
results.target: 請勿使用傳送門，除非所有3位玩家都準備好。

results.source: Wait for 2 minutes before activating the shrine.
results.target: 等待2分鐘再啟用神殿。

results.source: Do not start the raid. I will return in 5 minutes.
results.target: 不啟動 團隊副本。我將在5分鐘後返回。

results.source: Player_007 will meet us near Gate_02 in 10 seconds.
results.target: Player_007 將在 10 秒後於 Gate_02 會合。

results.source: If the boss targets you, move away from the group.
results.target: 如果 boss 目標你，就遠離群體。

results.source: 我五分鐘後回來，請不要開始。
results.target: I will return in five minutes, please do not start.

results.source: 請在 X:-12 Y:34 等我，不要使用傳送門。
results.target: Go to X:-12 Y:34, wait for me, don't use a portal.

results.source: 我們還需要 3 個人，等 2 分鐘再開始。
results.target: We still need 3 people, and we'll start in 2 minutes.

results.source: Please read the update notes before entering the dungeon.
results.target: 請先閱讀更新筆記再進入地牢。

results.source: This menu does not save changes automatically. Press Apply to confirm.
results.target: 此選項不自動儲存更改。請按「應用」以確認。

results.source: The maintenance window lasts 10 minutes. Do not close the application during this time.
results.target: 維護時段持續10分鐘。在此期間不得關閉應用程式。

note: Additional synthetic examples; passed means no transport failure and any guard warning preserves original. It does not certify semantic correctness or a game-wide accuracy rate.
